summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by The Hanover Insurance Group, Inc. reporting the appointment of Patricia A. Norton-Gatto as Principal Accounting Officer (Item 5.02), the results of the annual meeting of shareholders held on May 12, 2026 (Item 5.07), and the adoption of a new share repurchase program (Item 8.01). The annual meeting ratified directors, approved say-on-pay, and appointed auditors. There are no unusual or special-situation events; the filing is an ordinary current report with standard disclosures.
